long_biography.plain_text:
After earning a law degree at Stockholm University, Mörtstedt began as a junior judge and joined his family's Swedish property company as an analyst. He moved to Britain to study the London market, then co-founded CLS Holdings with his brother Sten and served as an executive director. He later shifted to a non-executive role, with a second board term ending in 2025.

Mörtstedt entered Caribbean hospitality after visiting Bequia. He acquired a closed guesthouse and adjacent sites and developed them into a resort. He opened Bequia Beach Hotel in 2009, created a construction company to manage the build, and expanded into other hotel properties in Saint Vincent and the Grenadines. He continues to run that hospitality business.
